critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2815 lines — same monolith concern from iteration_2 still applies. Splitting into routes/{auth,leagues,kickoff,lineup,mercato,auction}.py would greatly help maintainability.

api.ts URL guard regex `/^https?:\/\/[^/]+\.[a-z]{2,}/i` correctly rejects `https://onrender.com` (no dot after 'onrender'... wait: 'onrender.com' matches [^/]+\.[a-z]{2,} → 'onrender.com' → PASSES the regex). The explicit `BASE === 'https://onrender.com'` string check is what catches it. If the user picks any other invalid subdomain (e.g. https://fake.example) the URL guard will let it through and only the JSON-parse guard downstream will fire. Consider tightening (e.g. checking response ok or content-type) but acceptable for MVP.

KickoffScheduleIn Pydantic validator limits matchday to <=60 (so a value like 100 returns 422 not 400). The custom in-handler check `matchday < start_md or > end_md` therefore only triggers when the pydantic bound is respected; both are valid rejections in practice.
Backend uses `LINEUP_LOCK_MINUTES = 5` module constant — good; 423 Locked with Italian detail 'Formazione bloccata…' is returned as required.

The 2 failing backend tests are pre-existing (player seed count drift + auction-closed state) and unrelated to this iteration's scope.
